bullets.text: blunt today. not bad, just nothing sharp enough to catch on.
duck hasn't left okunoin since july. today's line puts the mind above everything else. the cedars have been there longer.
re-threading a brake cable. the housing came out full of old grit and one small dead spider.
an unopened can of coffee on the wall by the stairs, still warm. nobody came back for it.
a strong mind still puts on the wrong shoe first.
